summary: BiomX Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to update the maximum aggregate offering price under its existing at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The filing caps additional sales at $9.145 million, reflecting the remaining capacity under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, after prior sales of $3.708 million. The form is a routine shelf takedown update and does not constitute a special situation.
